name: skill-improver
summary: Turns a skill review's remediation list into executed changes, refusing anything that would fake capability to raise a score.
intents: 修复技能包被扣分的项
为什么我的技能被判 BLOCK
apply review findings to my skill
auto-fix missing LICENSE / ai-index / tags / triggers
为什么有些项工具不肯修
not_for: getting a score without changing anything
faking tests or demos to pass a review
theory_anchor: 有籍（可定位）/ 有证（可复跑）/ 有门禁（不达标不放行）
